declared difference (truth fix, catch structure): catch-no-400 took the first "catch (" within 4 lines after a
try's end, with no structural link: an unrelated catch after a finally-only try WARNed (line 7), the outer catch
of a nested try whose own catch answers 400 WARNed (line 13), a multi-catch was judged by its first clause
(IOException, line 17) and a try-with-resources was never read. The deciding catch is now the first clause
attached to the innermost enclosing try that catches the parse failure (NumberFormatException or a supertype),
read with javasrc.TryBlocks, and its own body decides; a catch that rethrows passes the failure to the enclosing
try's catch (rethrow(): the outer catch at line 28 decides, the inner one is no row).

package com.x;
public class BCat extends BWebServlet {
  void unrelated(String s) {
    try { Double.parseDouble(s); } finally { done(); }
    if (s != null) { use(s); }
    try { other(); }
    catch (Exception e) { log(e); }
  }
  void nested(String s) {
    try {
      try { Integer.parseInt(s); }
      catch (NumberFormatException e) { op.getResponse().sendError(400); }
    } catch (Exception e) { log(e); }
  }
  void multi(String s) {
    try { Long.parseLong(s); }
    catch (IOException e) { op.getResponse().sendError(400); }
    catch (IllegalStateException | NumberFormatException e) { v = 0; }
  }
  void resources(String s) {
    try (Reader r = open()) { Double.valueOf(s); }
    catch (NumberFormatException e) { v = 0; }
  }
  void rethrow(String s) {
    try {
      try { Integer.parseInt(s); }
      catch (Exception e) { throw e; }
    } catch (Exception e) { v = 0; }
  }
}
